name: Short Cut Indian Chickpea Korma with Cauliflower, Cilantro & Naan

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place in a large skillet along with korma curry sauce, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the curry. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, uncovered, until chickpeas are tender, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (254 g) can garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
1 (425 g) jar Indian korma curry sauce
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, and shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Set aside.

When the curry has about 5 minutes left, place cauliflower bag on a microwave-safe plate and pierce with a fork. Place in the microwave and cook on high, until tender, 3-4 minutes. Remove plate from microwave and carefully open the bag. Add to the curry, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
While the cauliflower is cooking, toast naan if desired, then cut into wedges.
Divide curry between bowls and sprinkle with cilantro. Serve with naan on the side and enjoy!
